services.name: python-lsp-server
services.description: python-lsp-server (pylsp) in TCP mode for interactive Python code understanding sessions.

services.name: serena
services.description: Serena MCP server in streamable HTTP mode for opt-in agent-facing semantic code understanding.
services.start_cmd: exec env SERENA_HOME="$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/serena-home" PATH="$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/uv-bin:$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" SERENA_USAGE_REPORTING=false "$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/uv-bin/serena" start-mcp-server --transport streamable-http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 20872 --context ide --enable-web-dashboard false --open-web-dashboard false

services.name: codebase-memory
services.description: Codebase-Memory MCP stdio server for opt-in agent-facing persistent code graph and semantic search.

services.name: codebadger-mcp
services.description: Codebadger MCP full Docker stack for opt-in CPG, data-flow, taint, slicing, and vulnerability analysis.

extension_slots.name: codegraph-mcp-server
extension_slots.note: Future MCP daemon. Do not install or run now. Copy into services[] only after the command and health behavior are known.
